la:verb:perlego.gloss: to view all over, examine thoroughly, scan, survey
senses: to view all over, examine thoroughly, scan, survey
to read through or over, read to the end; read aloud
la:verb:perlego.html:
per-lĕgo (pellĕgo, ; ; cf. P.), lēgi, lectum, 3, v. a.
In gen., to view all over, to examine thoroughly, scan, survey (only poet.): omnia oculis,: aliquid vultu,: perlege dispositas generosa per atria ceras,; .—
In partic., toread through, read to the end (class.): has (tabellas),: tertium (librum) de naturā deorum,: quando autem pelleget?: litteras,: (libros) praesta bis ne perlegant, § 33: leges,: reliquum deincipe die perlecturus, n. 16.—Absol.: sine perlegam,.—
Transf., to read any thing through, read aloud: leges perlege,: senatum,to read over the names of all the senators,: historiam,.

la:verb:perlabor.gloss: to slip or glide through or over; skim
senses: to slip or glide through or over; skim
la:verb:perlabor.html:
per-lābor, lapsus, 3 (
inf. pres. perlabier, ), v. dep. n., to slip or glide through (mostly poet.; perh. , is also a poet. reminiscence): isque (aër) ita per nostras acies perlabitur omnes,; ; sq.: nulla nec aërias volucris perlabitur auras,; : atque rotis summas levibus perlabitur undas,glides along the surface of the waves,: ad nos vix tenuis famae perlabitur aura,; : inde perlapsus ad nos et usque ad Oceanum Hercules,.

la:verb:perluceo.gloss: to shine through; to be visible, transparent or seen through
senses: to shine through; to be visible, transparent or seen through
to shine through, to be apparent, clear or intelligible
la:verb:perluceo.html:
perlūcĕo (pell-), xi, 2, v. n.
per-luceo
,
to shine through, shine forth, be visible; to be seen through, to be transparent, pellucid (class.).
Lit.: ita is pellucet, quasi laterna Punica,: tenuis ac perlucens aether,: amethysti perlucent omnes violaceo colore,: perlucens amictus,: Cretice, pelluces,i. e. you wear a transparent Cretan garment,: perlucens toga,; : perlucens avena,i. e. with many holes,: perlucens ruina,: pellucet omnis regia (because the walls are fallen down),.—
Trop., to shine through or forth, to appear; to be transparent, clear, intelligible: illud ipsum quod honestum decorumque dicimus quasi perlucet ex eis, quas commemoravi, virtutibus,: pellucens oratio,: mores dicentis ex oratione pelluceant,: perlucet omne regiae vitium domus,is apparent,.

la:verb:perluo.html:
per-lŭo (pelluo, ), ŭi, ūtum, 3, v. a.,
to wash off, to wash bathe, lave: manus undā,: aliquid aquā marinā,: aedem madentibus pennis,: sitientes artus,: sudor perluit ora,.—Pass., to wash one's self, to bathe: perluitur solitā Titania lympha,: in fluminibus perluuntur,; (in Oud., read diffluens).

la:verb:perlateo.gloss: to lie completely hidden; stay or remain hidden (throughout)
senses: to lie completely hidden; stay or remain hidden (throughout)
la:verb:perlateo.html:
per-lătĕo, ŭi, ēre, v. n.,
to lie completely hid, lie hid always, .
